newsitem.title: USA: Rocky Mountain to take charge, report loss.
newsitem.headline: Rocky Mountain to take charge, report loss.

text.p: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory Inc said Monday it expects to record a restructuring charge to income of approximately $2.1 million, pre-tax, in the fourth quarter of its fiscal 1997 which ended February 28, and it expects to report fourth quarter and full-year net losses after the charge.

The charge results from its intention to close nine underperforming stores and write down on certain other store assets considered impaired under provisions of Financial Accounting Standard 121, which governs accounting for the impairment of long-lived assets.
The effect of the charges is expected to produce a fourth quarter loss of approximately $1.9 million or $0.65 per share and a full year loss of approximately $1.2 million or $0.41 per share, it said.
Results, before the charges, would have been an estimated fourth quarter loss of $459,000 or $0.16 per share and a full year estimated profit of $247,000 or $.08 per share, the company said.
It said it expects to release final fourth quarter and fiscal 1997 financial results about May 15.
Through the closures and a program to sell certain other company-owned stores to potential franchisees, the company said it expects to improve profitability.
It said it was in the process of negotiating lease settlements for stores to be closed and expects to terminate operation of most such stores about May 31.
